thread_text:
Grace: PSA: brought my corgi "Pip" to the office for a quick run. will be doing a 10-min corgi cam at my desk 
Omar: corgi cam???? running to the meeting room now :running_man:
Grace: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/pip-corgi-cam|pip_sit.jpg> 00  
Tess: omg those little legs. is that a tiny bow tie?? :heart_eyes:
Grace: yes bow tie is optional but encouraged. he accepts belly rubs and treats. sign on desk: "Pip Patrol" 
Ben: does Pip approve of shared snacks? will he steal my bagel? :grimacing:
SnackBot: Reminder: shared food is on the honor system. Please avoid feeding pets human snacks. Recommended treats: plain carrot slices, small dog kibble. See https://intranet/pets for details.
Omar: poll: Pip's signature move = 1) rapid wiggle 2) head tilt of doom 3) naps dramatically across laptop. react with :one:/:two:/:three:
Tess: reacts with :one: and :three: 
Grace: posted short clip: <https://youtu.be/pip-wiggle> 00 Pip successfully distracted two engineers from a sprint planning meeting. productivity may have increased.
Ben: will set up a tiny corgi bell for desk visits. donations of tiny bow ties accepted at the kitchen drop box :bow:
Grace: signed Pip in with people-ops. he is a registered guest pet for today. will post an hourly photo thread. thanks for coming by :dog:
